subject: Evaluation collateral & mutual-action plan — onboarding exchange
messages:
From: Beth Chang <beth@clearsight.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation collateral exchange & MAP proposal — ClearSight / Redwood

Hi Camila / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and cost profile you showed looks promising for our charting and insights product. We're ready to run a short evaluation but need to exchange a few things first so legal and product can sign off.

High level ask: we'd like a mutual-action plan (MAP) that covers delivery of an evaluation dataset, a prompt pack and a small set of test cases. We also need to confirm usage constraints on the artifacts (no training, internal eval only, retention timeline). Can you confirm whether Redwood is comfortable with the following schedule?

- Week 0 (this week): exchange NDA + MAP draft
- Week 1: ClearSight delivers anonymized test set (approx. 8k records) + sample prompts
- Week 2: Redwood provides model run results + notes on config/quantization used
- Week 3: joint review and go/no-go for pilot purchase

Attachments: prototype_testcases.csv (sample), sample_data_note.pdf (high level).

Questions we have up front:
- Preferred transfer method (S3 presigned vs secure SFTP)?
- Can Redwood commit to deleting ClearSights data from any staging buckets after 90 days?
- Do you require any special anonymization checklist from our side?

Happy to hop on a quick call to finalize — aiming to close evaluation agreement by end-of-month.

Best,
Beth Chang
Head of ML Integrations 
ClearSight Financial

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Beth Chang <beth@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation collateral exchange & MAP proposal — ClearSight / Redwood

Hi Beth — thanks for the clear outline. Were aligned on doing a short, structured evaluation. Ill sketch a lightweight MAP below and loop in legal/security as needed. Marissa will lead the evaluation plan and deliverables.

Proposed MAP (high level)
- Day 0 (within 48h): sign mutual NDA / MAP document (we can use DocuSign)
- Day 3: ClearSight uploads anonymized eval dataset (S3 presigned link preferred)
- Day 7: Redwood ingests dataset, runs baseline config (gpt-equivalent open model), returns tokenized outputs + latency/cost matrix
- Day 10: Redwood provides prompt-pack guidance and test-case runbook; ClearSight runs local comparisons
- Day 14: joint review, feedback and next-steps (pilot/commit/contract)

Constraints to confirm (these are the ones Legal/Security typically asks for):
- Artifact license: evaluation-only; no derivative training or distribution outside ClearSight and Redwood engineering for 90 days
- Retention: ClearSights raw files will be deleted from Redwood staging within 90 days from upload date unless otherwise agreed in writing
- Access: only named engineers on the MAP are permitted to access the dataset; logs retained for audit

Action items Ill take now:
- Draft a MAP template and send as DocuSign link (cc: Rishi for commercial terms)
- Ask Marissa to attach the prompt pack/testcases and list the pass/fail criteria for the evaluation

Can you confirm the S3 presigned approach is acceptable and whether your legal team needs the MAP before we exchange data? If so, well expedite the draft.

Thanks — Camila Reyes
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Beth Chang <beth@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation collateral exchange & MAP proposal — Evaluation plan and deliverables

Beth / Camila — looping in the evaluation details. Ill own the test design and result package. Below is the evaluation plan I propose; please review and flag anything missing.

Evaluation plan (deliverables & pass criteria)
- Inputs: anonymized dataset (CSV, 8k rows), prompt_pack_v1.zip (JSON + example prompts), test_cases_v1.xlsx
- Runs: Redwood will run 3 model configs (baseline FP16, quantized INT8, optimized batch path) on the same prompt set
- Outputs: run_results_YYYYMMDD.tar.gz (token outputs), latency_report.csv, cost_estimate.pdf, qualitative_issue_log.txt

Pass criteria (example):
- Mean response latency < 400ms on p95 for qualifying prompts
- Semantic accuracy: scoring above 0.78 on our pairwise human eval for critical intents
- No PII leakage detected in a spot-check sample of 200 outputs

Usage & IP constraints (please confirm):
- License: Redwoods runs and reports are for ClearSight evaluation only; Redwood wont use the dataset to train any public or private models
- Distribution: Prompt pack and test cases are provided under evaluation terms and must not be shared with third parties
- Deletion: ClearSight requests deletion of raw uploads 90 days after upload; Redwood will provide deletion confirmation and audit log

Attachments Im including in this thread: prompt_pack_v1.zip (prompt definitions, few examples), test_cases_v1.xlsx (structured testcases).

Delivery notes:
- Preferred ingestion: S3 presigned link to a Redwood staging bucket (encrypted at rest).
- If your security team requests, we can support secure SFTP.

Let me know if you want a short video walkthrough of the prompt pack structure — I can record 10 minutes.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Principal Product, Evaluation & Evals
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Beth Chang <beth@clearsight.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation collateral exchange & MAP proposal — commercial timeline + MAP draft

Beth — quick note on the commercial side and the MAP draft. Weve created a short MAP that mirrors the schedule above; I attached RDW-MAP-draft.pdf for your review. Key commercial points:

- MAP ID: RDW-2345-MAP
- Target close (evaluation sign-off): 2025-08-28
- Offer: If ClearSight signs MAP + commit to pilot by 2025-08-25, we can lock a 10% credit against the first-month committed spend.
- Procurement: we typically need PO or signed SOW for Dedicated/Dedicated+ support. For hosted evaluation, a signed MAP and NDA are sufficient to start.

Please confirm procurement contact and any required vendor forms. Once we have the signed MAP/DocuSign link, well provision an encrypted staging bucket and send a presigned upload URL.

Attachment: RDW-MAP-draft.pdf (summary of milestones, signatory block). HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/HS-98765

Rgds,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Beth Chang <beth@clearsight.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation collateral exchange & MAP proposal — onboarding exchange

Thanks all — we reviewed internally and we can proceed on the terms you outlined. A few final confirmations before we upload:

- We accept the MAP milestones and target close date of 2025-08-28. Ill circulate the PO and send the signed DocuSign for the MAP by EOD tomorrow: https://docusign.net/sign/abc123
- Transfer method: we prefer S3 presigned upload to the Redwood staging bucket. Please send the link + temp credentials.
- Anonymization: we have a short checklist and will run it prior to upload. Ill attach the anonymization_checklist.pdf to the DocuSign packet.
- Constraints acknowledged: evaluation-only, no training, deletion after 90 days.

Attachments: anonymization_checklist.pdf (will be in DocuSign packet).

One ask: can you confirm who the named engineers will be for access (we need that on our side)? We have two engineers: Diego (diego@clearsight.ai) and Lina (lina@clearsight.ai). We'd like to put them on the access list.

Once we have the presigned link we'll upload the full test set and prompt pack in one archive (approx 120MB).

Looking forward to the run.

Best,
Beth Chang
Head of ML Integrations
ClearSight Financial
